text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I think if you press a letter,
predictive text options will pop up, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho, there they are.
They're lined up on top...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's right. As long as you type the first letter,
the phone will automatically pick words
you use frequently.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to pick the words you want to type.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho. Let's see, to select, I tilt
this round thing and press the middle... right.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Man, technology really is advancing day by day.
It's truly incredible, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I saw it on TV before, but apparently it's important not to take things for granted.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Maybe by not being satisfied with how things are,
you come up with ideas on how to make them even better.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Never taking things for granted, never settling for the present...
That is how true innovation is born, I see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If training had an innovation like mobile phones,
we could improve our skills even further—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I just had an idea.
Why don't we head out to the track for a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Pitter-patter-pat!
Turf course training is all doneâ

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just a quick lap around
the usual dirt course like this...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So you planned out the transitions between
each training session in advance to boost efficiency!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it a try too!
Off to my usual course, zoom zoom zoom...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From this day on, Wonder Acute seemed to have had a breakthrough,
and her training grew remarkably sharp.
